275546926.description:
Crystal & Gemstone Specimen Collection
Natural & Treated Mineral Lot
Total Weight: 12.2 lbs
This diverse collection features a wide variety of natural mineral specimens and polished stones, totaling over 12 pounds. The lot includes high-quality raw clusters, decorative bookend-style chunks, and polished metaphysical shapes. Notable specimens include a large, deep purple amethyst druzy cluster, a vibrant blue celestine cluster, and multiple aura-coated quartz points featuring iridescent prismatic finishes. The variety of textures, from raw crystalline formations to mirror-polished surfaces, makes this an ideal lot for collectors or home decor.
Large Amethyst druzy cluster with well-defined crystalline points and matrix backing
Substantial Blue Celestine (Celestite) cluster with translucent crystalline structure
Polished Lapis Lazuli palm stone and blue-and-white polished stone egg
Treated Aura Quartz points and iridescent spheres with prismatic light-refracting coatings
Pair of Agate bookend-style specimens featuring gold-tone metallic accents on top surfaces
Includes assorted tumbled stones, a polished banded jasper rectangle, and a natural seashell
Condition:
Very good overall condition across the entire collection. Natural specimens show typical geological variations and crystal terminations as expected for raw minerals. Polished stones feature smooth finishes with minimal surface wear or micro-scratches. Aura-treated items retain bright, consistent iridescence. No significant damage or major chips observed beyond the natural inclusions and rough-hewn edges characteristic of unpolished mineral specimens. All pieces are structurally sound and suitable for display.
